svg.title: One write, from a user to a device
svg.desc: The user sends a set to the gateway. The gateway mints a permission token (ptok) with the user's grants and sends the query to the link with the token in the attachment. The link's SDK checks the token and only then calls the driver, writes an audit record and answers with a status.

g.text: A check that fails answers permission_denied: the driver never sees the call.

g.text: Links trust the gateway's key; the user's grants decide what it may mint.
